# Navigation icons

Generated with the built-in image generation tool, transparent PNG originals retained here. Lossless WebP delivery copies are in `src/assets/icons/`. These are original illustrations, not official GitHub logos.

Prompt template:

> Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a single small website navigation icon for an original worn 1980s cassette player interface, one of a coherent set of three. Subject: [SUBJECT] Style: straight-on, flat bold pictogram, solid dark desaturated forest green #294b43 with extremely subtle worn silk-screen ink edges. Centered icon occupies about 75 percent of a square canvas; equal generous padding, compact thick shapes and strong legibility when shown at 24px. Background genuinely transparent. No enclosing circle, no tile, no frame, no text, no letters, no watermark, no mockup, no shadows, no scene, no extra symbols. Deliver only this ONE icon as a transparent PNG. Match an understated aged cassette-player interface on warm ivory.

Subjects:

- home.png: A simple house / home silhouette with a pitched roof, small chimney, and one centered doorway. Meaning: creator's personal homepage.
- repository.png: A clean Git repository branching symbol: three round nodes connected by a thick branching path. Meaning: source code repository. Do not use a cat or octopus, letters, or a trademark logo.
- sponsor.png: One full rounded heart silhouette. Meaning: sponsor / support the creator.
